# sscmex v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

> SSCMA NIF bindings for SG2002 chip

## Modules

- [SSCMEx](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.md): SSCMA NIF bindings for SG2002 chip (reCamera).
- [SSCMEx.Camera](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Camera.md): Camera interface for SG2002 (reCamera).
- [SSCMEx.Device](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Device.md): Device singleton wrapper for SG2002 chip.
- [SSCMEx.Engine](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Engine.md): SSCMA-Micro EngineCVI wrapper.
- [SSCMEx.Examples.CameraInference](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Examples.CameraInference.md): Full example: load model, configure camera to model input size, capture one frame,
then run inference.
- [SSCMEx.Image](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Image.md): Image structure used by camera capture and model inference.
- [SSCMEx.Model](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Model.md): High-level API for ML model inference using SSCMA-Micro.
- [SSCMEx.Tick](https://sscmex.hexdocs.pm/SSCMEx.Tick.md): Same-clock helpers for `SSCMEx.Image.timestamp`.
